name: Fix runIdToEpoch off-by-1ms bug — /post-now returns no videos
goal: Fix critical bug: runIdToEpoch('scs001-2026-03-16T13-02-47-539Z') returns epoch 1773666167539 but actual run dir is run-1773666167538 (1ms off). /post-now, /caption, /queue all return 'no ready videos' even though 30 captioned mp4s exist. Fix: replace epoch-based existsSync with a directory scan helper findCaptionedMp4().
rationale: Operator has 30 captioned videos ready to post. /post-now, the primary posting workflow command, returns 'No ready videos found on disk' due to the 1ms epoch mismatch. This directly blocks gate progress. Fix unblocks all 30 videos immediately.
swarm: NOT USED — surgical edit to commands.ts. Direct write.
